corpus.corpus_note: Gutenberg / arXiv / Wikipedia (en + de,fr,es,ja,zh,ru) / CPython v3.12.8 Lib; calibration-overlapping documents are pre-excluded.

document_provenance.note: counts are recomputed from this shard's own context_index rows; they are not transferable to another panel

panel_name: malaiwah Qwen3.8-27B suite v5, shard 0 -- 512 contexts

parameters.mask: all ones over the full context

registry_panel.note: the registry record's own source is a GitHub receipt; this build re-derives the same token digest from the public dataset instead of trusting that record

canonical_token_aggregate.rule: sha256(newline join of per-record token_ids_json_sha256) == suite_token_hash_sha256, the aggregate a resolved panel binding recomputes

panel_token_legacy_aggregate.rule: sha256(empty-string join of per-record token_ids_json_sha256) == the historical receipts' panel_token_sha256_legacy

shard_aggregate.rule: sha256(concat of per-context token_sha256 hex in context_index order) == suite manifest suite_token_sha256 == registry panel identity.panel_token_sha256

tokenizer_identity.rule: sha256(tokenizer.json) == suite manifest model_identity.tokenizer_sha256 and sha256(config.json) == model_identity.config_sha256 and the model config's declared text vocabulary equals the manifest's vocab_size

selection_rule: every context of the sealed shard, in the shard suite-manifest's context_index order; window N carries context_index[N]'s token ids verbatim, its stratum as the window domain and its source cluster as the window document_id. Masks are all-ones over the full context, so every causal next-token position is scored. No RNG, no tokenizer, no re-derivation from text.

inherited_scan.contamination_scan: Unicode NFKC, casefold, every Unicode word token

separation.method: this tool runs no scan; the parent suite manifest records the scan its builder ran
separation.note: Gutenberg / arXiv / Wikipedia (en + de,fr,es,ja,zh,ru) / CPython v3.12.8 Lib; calibration-overlapping documents are pre-excluded.

tokenizer.note: no tokenizer was loaded by this tool; token ids are transported from the sealed suite. Identity is PROVED against the suite manifest's model_identity digests, not inherited from a repository name.
